# Zenius AI Codebase & Architecture Specification

Zenius AI is a premium, real-time e-learning and virtual classroom platform built on a modern MERN stack. It incorporates WebRTC audio/video rooms, cooperative whiteboards, and Google Gemini AI features for generating study quizzes.

## Tech Stack Summary

- **Frontend**: React (v18), Vite, Zustand (State Management), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion, Socket.io-client, Recharts, HTML2Canvas, jsPDF.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), Socket.io, Helmet (CSP/Security Headers), CORS, Cookie Parser, bcryptjs, Multer, Nodemailer.
- **AI Integration**: Google Generative AI SDK (`@google/generative-ai` with `gemini-2.5-flash`).
- **Media Uploads**: Cloudinary API integrations.

---

## Directory Organization

```
├── client/                  # React Frontend (Vite)
│   ├── public/              # Static public files (favicon, manifest, robots, sitemaps)
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── api/             # Frontend API request handlers (Axios clients)
│   │   ├── components/      # UI components (quizzes, live room, whiteboard, layout)
│   │   ├── hooks/           # Custom React hooks (WebRTC peer connections, UI listeners)
│   │   ├── pages/           # View pages grouped by role (auth, public, student, instructor, admin, legal)
│   │   ├── store/           # Zustand stores (authentication, user profile, UI themes)
│   │   ├── utils/           # Formatting & utility functions
│   │   ├── App.jsx          # Route declarations and role gates
│   │   └── main.jsx         # Application bootstrapper
│   └── vite.config.js       # Vite build setup (conditional production rollup obfuscator)
│
├── server/                  # Node.js Express Backend
│   ├── config/              # MongoDB & Cloudinary service configurations
│   ├── controllers/         # Request handling logic mapping Express routers
│   ├── middleware/          # Security (CSRF, CSP, Auth, SSRF Shield, rate limiters)
│   ├── models/              # Mongoose collection schemas (User, Course, Progress, LiveRoom)
│   ├── queue/               # Asynchronous tasks and processing queues
│   ├── routes/              # Express API endpoints
│   ├── services/            # Google Gemini AI services, SMTP, and Cloudinary managers
│   ├── socket/              # WebRTC & Whiteboard Socket.io events
│   ├── utils/               # Sanitizers, validation helpers, and response wrappers
│   └── index.js             # Main server setup and dynamic robots/sitemaps server
```

---

## Main Functional Components

### 1. Multi-Role Gateways
- **Student Dashboard**: Browse catalogs, track course progress, take quizzes, view certificates.
- **Instructor Dashboard**: Create courses, manage lectures, upload/add note links, view grading analytics.
- **Admin Dashboard**: System administration (users, support tickets, approval queues, feature flags).

### 2. Real-Time Interactions (WebRTC & Socket.IO)
- **Video Rooms**: P2P audio/video streaming via native browser WebRTC connections.
- **Shared Whiteboard**: HTML5 Canvas synchronized instantly across room members using Socket.io.
- **Class Chat**: Live text messaging in classroom side panels.

### 3. Gemini AI integration
- **AI Quiz Builder**: Automatically creates MCQ quizzes from uploaded files (PDF, DOCX, TXT) using `gemini-2.5-flash`.
- **Engagement Logs**: Records student live room entry/exit to track attendance.

---

## API Spec & Routes

All API endpoints are prefixed with `/api`.

### Auth & User Routes (`/api/auth`, `/api/users`)
- `POST /auth/register` - Create student account
- `POST /auth/login` - Secure login (with brute-force lockout checks)
- `POST /auth/logout` - Clear cookies
- `GET /auth/me` - Fetch profile state
- `GET /users/enrolled` - Get student's enrolled courses

### Courses & Material Routes (`/api/courses`, `/api/material`)
- `GET /courses` - Get all published courses
- `POST /courses` - Create new course outline
- `PUT /courses/:id` - Edit curriculum nodes
- `POST /material/notes` - Upload file resource or save external link notes

### Analytics & Quizzes (`/api/analytics`, `/api/quiz`)
- `GET /analytics/course/:id` - Fetch course completion metrics
- `POST /quiz/generate` - Trigger Gemini AI MCQ generator

---

## Security Framework

- **CSRF Defense**: Double-submit cookie pattern mapping validation tokens on all mutable HTTP requests.
- **Content Security Policy (CSP)**: Strict Helmet configurations allowing resource loading from trusted origins only.
- **Lockout Shield**: Temporary 30-minute account ban after 5 consecutive failed passwords.
- **SSRF Blockers**: Validates URL hosts during note linking, rejecting loopback or private ranges.
